paragraphs: The moulded handle is the whole design problem of a large water bottle. Five litres is more than most people can carry by gripping a smooth cylinder, so the handle is blown into the body itself rather than added, and the shape of the bottle follows from it.
The set holds 42,969 polygons and 42,922 vertices in quads and tris with mixed UV layout, in blue. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $59 it suits packaging and product visualisation, retail and e-commerce imagery, advertising, kitchen and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

A plate loaded press moves on a fixed path, which is what makes it safe to fail on. The weight can be stacked far beyond anything a free barbell would allow, because the machine rather than the lifter is holding the line of movement.
The model holds 295,236 polygons and 302,317 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied as a set. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits gym and fitness visualisation, equipment marketing, interior and architectural scenes, e-commerce imagery, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2022.

A large format desk is a wall of identical channel strips, and that repetition is the point: an engineer works by muscle memory in the dark, so every strip has to be laid out the same way and feel the same under the hand.

The model is dense at 895,972 polygons and 467,551 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, which is what the controls require, in the light finish. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits studio and broadcast visualisation, audio equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, film and television sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

The portable cassette player is back in production because the object turned out to matter more than the format. A tape has to be flipped, rewound and waited for, and a generation that never used one buys them for exactly that friction.
The model holds 82,792 polygons and 86,304 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in brown and supplied with a cassette. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits product and retro technology visualisation, e-commerce imagery, advertising, period and interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

The chequered flag has meant one thing for over a century and nobody is quite sure why that pattern. Paired with a helmet it becomes the standard visual for motorsport in general, used anywhere the subject is competition rather than a specific race.
The model is light at 21,240 polygons and 22,227 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplying the flag together with the helmet. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $59 it suits motorsport and event visualisation, broadcast and sports graphics, advertising, signage and decor work, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A manpack radio is a compromise between range and what a person can carry up a hill. With a satellite antenna attached it stops depending on line of sight altogether, which is the difference between talking to the next valley and talking to another continent.
The model holds 75,133 polygons and 76,124 vertices in quads and tris with mixed UV layout, supplied with the SATCOM antenna, and carries StemCell certification.
At $59 it suits defence and communications visualisation, equipment marketing, training material, character accessories, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Side by side doors trade shelf width for the ability to open in a narrow kitchen, and stainless steel became the default finish because it reads as professional equipment rather than as furniture. Both decisions are about how the room is meant to feel.
The model holds 279,439 polygons and 283,954 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 13 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits kitchen and interior visualisation, appliance marketing and e-commerce imagery, advertising, film sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

Loitering munitions blur the line between a missile and an aircraft. They fly, they wait, they are steered by an operator watching a video feed, and then they do not come back, which makes them cheap in a way that has changed how small units fight.
The model is light at 36,454 polygons and 18,854 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification. A second build is offered separately.
At $59 it suits defence visualisation, news and documentary graphics, simulation, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Containment is one of science fiction's most reliable engines. A sealed capsule inside a shipping container implies that something is being moved which should not be opened, and the story writes itself before a single line of dialogue.
The model holds 95,522 polygons and 98,041 vertices in quads and tris with mixed UV layout, and carries StemCell certification.
At $59 it suits science fiction film and animation, game environments and props, concept art, technology illustration and editorial work. On sale since 2026.

A guard booth is the smallest occupied building most sites have, and it has to do a great deal: shelter, sightlines in every direction, a desk, and enough presence to make people slow down before they reach it.
The model holds 53,794 polygons and 56,265 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.

At $59 it suits architectural and site visualisation, security and facilities presentation, industrial and urban scenes, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

The self service kiosk moved work from staff to customers and made it feel like a convenience. The screen angle, the height and the placement of the card reader are all calculated around somebody standing with luggage in one hand.
The model is very light at 6,828 polygons and 7,252 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so several fit in one scene. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits airport, retail and hospitality visualisation, equipment marketing, interface mockups, architectural interiors, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2022.

A large diaphragm condenser on a boom is the visual shorthand for a recording session, and it has become the shorthand for podcasting too. The shock mount around it is doing real work: the biggest enemy of a studio recording is the desk it sits on.

The model holds 73,721 polygons and 74,340 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 6 maps at 4096x4096, supplied with its stand. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits studio and broadcast visualisation, audio equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, podcast and interview scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

A crushed bottle is a different object from an intact one, and recycling imagery needs both. Compressed for transport, the shape is unpredictable, and modelling a set of them is the only honest way to fill a bale or a bin.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the crushed bottles as static pieces. It is built to CheckMate specification.

At $57 the set suits recycling and environmental visualisation, waste management presentation, education and documentary work, advertising, film set dressing and game environments. On sale since 2026.

The handheld card terminal moved payment away from the counter, which changed how restaurants and market stalls actually work. Everything about the device is built around being handed to a stranger and handed back several hundred times a day.

The model is built at subdivision level, 6,737 polygons and 7,189 vertices with non-overlapping UVs, supplied with a card, so it smooths cleanly for close product work. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits retail and hospitality visualisation, payment technology marketing, e-commerce imagery, interface mockups, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.
